units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:5:2">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כהדין דשתי חמרא בתר בילני</he> (read <he>בליני</he>) as if one drinks wine after bathing (for medicinal purposes, when the wine which he drinks after meal cannot be considered as a continuation of the draught taken before meal; v. <cite ref="A01819"><he>אֲלוּנְטִית</he> II</cite>).

Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ bot. as much as one will ask (for the fruits left over) on a hot summer day בתר ב׳ after bathing time (when he is anxious to sell).—*Denom. בַּלָּנִיּוֹת f. pl. (= balnearia) bathing apparel.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:5">B. Bath. IV, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b">67ᵇ</cite>, Bab. ed.) <he>ואת הב׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="F00040"><he>וִילָאוֹת</he></cite> q. v.).
